name: How much does it really cost to replace a bathtub in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How much does it really cost to replace a bathtub in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text:
There is no reliable single price for bathtub replacement because the total depends on the tub, surround, demolition, disposal, plumbing, waterproofing, finishes, and access. Online homeowner reports show wide quote differences, so comparing scope is more useful than comparing one headline number.

Context: A basic tub swap can cost far less than removing a cast-iron unit, rebuilding damaged walls, changing a valve, or installing custom tile. Material selections and the amount of surrounding work can change the estimate substantially.

Key factors:
- Acrylic, steel, fiberglass, or cast iron
- Prefabricated surround versus tile
- Plumbing relocation and hidden damage
- Disposal, permits, and inspection needs

Practical guidance: Request a written estimate that identifies allowances, exclusions, potential concealed-condition charges, and finish selections. Elite Remodeling & Design can develop the design and construction scope together rather than pricing the tub separately from related bathroom work.

Treat unusually low quotes cautiously if they omit demolition, waterproofing, finish repairs, or cleanup.
acceptedAnswer.description: The price varies widely with the tub and surround, demolition, plumbing, waterproofing, tile, disposal, and hidden damage. Compare itemized scopes rather than headline totals. Ask whether the estimate includes finish repairs, permits, inspections, cleanup, and allowances for concealed conditions.
